answer: Earning the standing takes 4 seasons and 120 inspections under chalk watchers; forging it takes the same, per fake. The gate asks for Ripe chalkman licence with chalkmen attestation before the first reward — a licence chalkmen renew after chalk audits. Check the reef at the gate, count the wander at payout, and keep the ledge on file for the audit. The farm cannot afford all three.
